messages:
olivia_marketing: Heads-up: SaltPoint case study confirmed tomorrow 10:30am PT with their Head of Product. We're aiming for a lightweight launch: blog + 2 social posts next Wed, and webinar in two weeks. Need hero quote, logo permission, and legal clearance on any metrics. Who can own assets?

devin_sdr: I can own inbound routing + nurture. Will tag leads campaign=saltpoint-case and route to Demo SDR. Need final publish URL by Tue EOD so I can set the registration redirect.

rao_content: I'll handle ASR -> 1-pass human clean transcript, plus 3 social snippets and two clips (30s, 45s). Please drop raw audio in the shared folder ASAP after the call.

meera_se: I'll upload raw recording & timestamps. Also can pull a short demo clip if they mention the benchmark around 14:12.

legal_team: Quick note: any numeric claims (e.g., "2x throughput", "40% cost reduction") need a supporting sentence or timeframe from SaltPoint. Send verbatim quote + context to legal-review@redwood.com. Standard turnaround ~48 hours.

olivia_marketing: Got it. Rao, when you ASR, please annotate any lines with hard numbers as [CLAIM: needs source]. Meera, ask SaltPoint to confirm the 2x number on-record in chat during the interview if possible.

launch-bot: Reminder: embargo window placeholder set for 2026-05-05 08:00 PDT if legal clears by 2026-05-03 17:00.

devin_sdr: If legal delays metrics, we'll still publish the blog and social with qualitative language and hold webinar emails. I want the blog live to start routing inbound.

rao_content: Cool. I'll prepare two hero options to send to legal:
1) "SaltPoint scales inference without breaking the bank"
2) "SaltPoint doubled throughput and lowered costs by 30% with Redwood Inference"
Which should we send?

legal_team: Send option 1 for immediate branding approval. Option 2 requires the exact period/method for the 2x/30% numbers; otherwise we'll suggest a qualitative phrasing. Please forward any Slack DM or email from SaltPoint confirming metrics.

meera_se: SaltPoint okayed logo use via email earlier. I'll drop that permission into the shared folder and paste the snippet here after the call.

olivia_marketing: Perfect. Action plan quick:
- interview tomorrow -> meera uploads raw audio + markers same day
- rao ASR + tag claims -> draft clips + hero options by Fri AM
- legal review sent Fri AM -> approvals by Sun if possible
- publish blog + social Wed; webinar promo separate pending legal

meera_se: Also, moderator slide idea: one slide with 3 bullets: outcome, how they used Redwood, CTA/demo link. I'll create and upload template.

launch-bot: Note: add campaign tag campaign=saltpoint to any outbound nurture links once publish URL is provided.

devin_sdr: One more ask: can someone draft a 1-line webinar hook for the signup? Short and benefit-forward.

rao_content: Draft hooks: 
- "How SaltPoint scaled inference across teams without ballooning costs."
- "Doubling throughput: SaltPoint's roadmap with Redwood Inference."
I'll pick one after ASR cleanup.

olivia_marketing: Thanks team. I'll create the shared folder and add legal_team + devin_sdr + rao_content + meera_se. Post raw link & timecodes here after interview and I'll route to Devin for nurture setup.
